timing: After CLI collection started, before inspecting selected candidates or condition effects. This is a supplemental analysis specification, not a fully preregistered inferential test.
primary: Model-specific 2x2 selection counts and within-store differences; four candidates, two selected; 12 independent stores.
supplemental_randomization_test: For each of six area-repeat blocks shared across backends, jointly flip the menu-detail or repetition factor labels for all four rotations. Enumerate 2^6 flips of block contrasts under a sharp null of no effect of that factor on any choice. Preserve positions and the other factor. Two-sided p; Holm adjust the two factor tests. Only use complete balanced blocks.
limitations: Six randomized blocks, twelve fixed stores, supplied corpus, two fixed backends. Not independent 192-store data or a population sample; menu detail changes menu identities, price values, information quantity and text length together.
choice_model: Supplementary ridge conditional choice likelihood over the six possible 2-of-4 subsets, store contrasts within area plus position contrasts, centered detail and repetition and their interaction. Fixed ridge lambda=1, model-specific fits. No predictive cross-validation, causal map-ranking claim, coefficient confidence interval or XGBoost fit.
